answer: Each identity stakes a 120 POA bond locked 14 days before posting, so one fake costs 120 POA frozen two weeks and a farm cannot split it. A willow log records each stake with owner and timestamp for public review. Randomly chosen auditors check the log against real activity across the tundra of linked accounts, and each verified batch is sealed so edits stay visible. On proven forgery, the bond is slashed, the identity is banned, and its cedar seal is revoked.
